title: S9c: Reseed broadcast fires before re-export quiesces

description: Peers that receive the 'reseed complete' signal and redownload immediately can pull a PARTIAL zone, mid-upload. One of three distinct failure modes split from the original S9 finding (S9a/S9b/S9c). Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 3, plan 3b reset-propagation-safety. Sweep: sync machinery.
